name: wire-round-trip-all-shapes
description: Produces every operation shape the wire format has to carry: a left child, a right child whose right origin is another element, a right child whose right origin is end-of-document, and a delete.

expected.rationale: PROJECT_SPEC.md section 6: the Editor.Infrastructure encoding is a second implementation alongside the TypeScript serialiser, so the corpus must exercise it. 'b' then prepending 'a' makes a left child; appending 'c' after 'b' makes a right child with no right origin; inserting 'x' between 'a' and 'b' makes a right child whose right origin is 'b'. Losing the distinction between the last two is exactly the encoding bug this catches, since both have no right-origin id.
